variants.name: 暖灯厨房
variants.detail: VARIANT A / Warm lantern kitchen: dusk in a reclaimed wooden cabin kitchen with golden hanging lantern and ivy around the boarded window, ruined city outside in subdued purple silhouettes. Character on the left in white blouse and lavender apron, gentle confident expression, lightly holding the fridge door open on the right and presenting a small basket of crisp fresh greens and apples. Three-quarter close framing, naturally placed hands, fridge with readable clocks. Warm amber rim light against lavender accents. Not kneeling or crouching; seated on a normal kitchen stool or standing half-length beside a raised countertop-height mini fridge.
variants.prompt: Generate a completely new square high-resolution Steam Workshop cover, 1536x1536 or higher, for the mod titled exactly 「蘇清的返鲜冰箱」. References: image 1 is the mandatory CHARACTER IDENTITY model sheet. Image 2 and image 3 are this user's APPROVED MOD COVER STYLE references. Image 4 shows the ACTUAL FRIDGE geometry/design in four views. Identity takes priority: preserve same slender adult dragon woman and facial proportions, long silver-white hair, pale lavender eyes, paired pale curled dragon horns, pale lavender wings, long WHITE SCALED tail, white/lavender rose ornaments and ribbons. Not a different girl, not a child, not chibi. Match the other covers' refined pixel-art anime style: clean expressive anime face with deliberate visible pixel edges, richly detailed pixel-textured wooden environment, saturated lavender with golden light, detailed objects that explain the mod. Composition: scene/character/fridge in upper roughly 72 percent; lower 28 percent is the signature dark-purple woven signboard with gold metal frame, lavender flowers, rose/dragon motifs matching the approved covers. Exact Chinese typography on this lower sign, first line 「蘇清的」, second larger line 「返鲜冰箱」. Exact name, do not substitute 鮮 for 鲜. No version numbers, no B42, no extra slogans, no watermark, no unrelated text. Main appliance is the modeled freestanding mini fridge, ivory enamel cabinet, lavender top and control panel, analog clock plus digital display, slim vertical handle, dark lower grille. Keep its compact mini-fridge form, not a giant tall fridge. The refrigerator and character must both be recognizable at thumbnail size. Preserve both horns, at least one clear wing, and visible white-scaled tail in the scene. No blue sprite companion. Food restoration should read through ordinary fresh vegetables and subtle lavender indicator glow, not a huge magical effect. Avoid smooth photorealism and painterly airbrush; match the pixel-finished reference covers. variants.name: 夜间工坊
variants.detail: VARIANT B / Midnight time-restoration workshop: strongly different from variant A. Moody blue-purple moonlit workshop, character on the right wearing a modest white/lavender work jacket with rose hair ornament and a small tool belt; she is carefully finishing the compact fridge on a sturdy bench on the left, one hand resting on its top/control panel, the other holding a screwdriver away from her face. A metal alarm clock, digital wristwatch, pocket watch and analog wristwatch are arranged clearly on the workbench as recipe cues, with wire and small metal sheets. Fridge CLOSED, status lamps glow lavender; a plate of restored apples rests alongside. Cool moonlight through rainy window, small warm desk lamp as contrast. Keep graceful original adult body proportions and visible dragon tail curving around stool.

variants.name: 清晨储藏间
variants.detail: VARIANT C / Fresh morning pantry: strongly different brighter daylight version. A sunlit wood-and-brick safehouse pantry with open window, soft morning beams and green climbing leaves; no night lantern-dominated atmosphere. Character near center-left in elegant practical white/lavender dress with short apron, smiling softly toward viewer, holding one fresh apple at chest level. Compact fridge on right with door open slightly, neat vegetables, fruit and a prepared meal visible, no oversized frozen chamber. White-scaled tail visible along left foreground, lavender wing arcs behind her. Fridge as second co-star, close readable face and appliance. Airy lavender-green-gold palette, still rich deliberate pixel-art texture and same purple/gold lower title plaque.
